limits: Paz selected here is the adult original GZ prisoner incarnation with short cropped blond hair, pale worn collared/buttoned tunic, sleeves rolled at elbows, bare lower legs/feet. She is not the TPP medical hallucination with braids/blue gown and not PW school-cover outfit.

Dark/orange and night-vision original capture lighting occludes neutral pale shirt hue, reverse seams and some garment hem details. Sprite pale beige-grey-green hue, cloth stain placement, exact buttons/finger topology and feet anatomy remain closest_supported, not exact model/material1:1.

These calm support/defense, authored normals/jump/guard, light recoil/tired-rest KO, empty-hand signal/protection/CQC/composure poses are bonus versus simulation after restraint release, not a canonical recovered GZ duel or an assertion that original trauma never occurred. No wounds, graphic violence, underwear, chains or bomb scenes appear.

B LEFT01 omitted a body and contains11 rather than12 poses; it is rejected, preserved and replaced by independently regenerated B LEFT02 containing12 complete bodies. No pixel erasure/paint/mirroring was used.
